steps.label: Liveness check
Cloth draping over a sphere onto the floor
Precondition: 1 soft body
Precondition: 400 particles (20x20 grid)
Precondition: the soft render mode defaults to wireframe
Precondition: the cloth spawns flat at y=1.5, above the sphere
Switch the soft bodies to PBR (shaded) rendering
Change: the mode is now shaded
Let the cloth fall and drape over the sphere onto the floor (~3.3s)
Change: the cloth has fallen -- min Y after draping is below its flat starting height
Invariant: no velocity explosion
Both modes at once (wire over shaded)
Screenshot: the draped cloth rendered as a PBR surface + wire overlay
Preset switch (cloth -> jelly) reconciles the shaded instances
Precondition: 1 soft body
Shaded only
Let the jelly cube fall and land
Screenshot: the jelly cube rendered as a PBR surface
Rope has no triangle surface -> stays wireframe only (0 shaded instances)
Precondition: 1 soft body
Shaded mode requested, but the rope contributes no shaded surface
Step the rope
Invariant: the app is still alive with a shaded rope requested (no surface drawn)
Restore the default wireframe mode
Neg: an unknown render mode is rejected
